text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training with Air Groove, she was 
constantly dozing off...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry. Could you go over that 
explanation one more time?
choice_data_list: Are you okay? You don't look so good.
Are you okay? You don't look so good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I haven't been able to sleep lately. 
The student council work has been piling 
up, you see."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I start tinkering with it before bed, 
before I know it, morning has come...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, it is something I must do 
myself. You need not concern yourself with 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Air Groove acts tough, she still 
seems unwell. I should keep a close eye on 
her.
